item.title: Sheriff's Office BBQ Heats Up After Inmate Sneaks Off For Port-A-Potty Rendezvous
item.description: A Florida inmate assigned to a BBQ serving line decided to get frisky in an incredibly risky move.

item.title: Dan Hurley Loses His Mind, Gets Ejected With One Second Left Against Marquette
item.description: Dan Hurley explodes over a late no-call in UConn’s loss to Marquette, gets ejected by referee Greg Evans, and watches the Golden Eagles secure a 68-62 upset over the No. 4 Huskies.

item.title: It Sure Sounds Like Tarik Skubal Has One Foot Out The Door In Detroit
item.description: Tarik Skubal confirms the Tigers haven't made a single extension offer as the Cy Young winner prepares to headline free agency in the next MLB offseason.

item.title: NHL Media Asking Players About 'Heated Rivalry' Is Inappropriate And Unprofessional
item.description: A Nashville Predators beat reporter was asking player's to give their take on "Heated Rivalry" — a sexually-explicit show about gay hockey players.

item.title: IndyCar Driver Dennis Hauger Drops Jaw-Dropping Save
item.description: IndyCar returned to Phoenix Raceway for the first time since 2018 as Josef Newgarden won, Dennis Hauger saved a wild spin, and Álex Palou’s title streak took a hit.

item.title: Not So Curious: Gorillas Snub Tossed Curious George Toy
item.description: San Antonio Zoo’s gorillas go viral after zookeepers toss a Curious George plush into their habitat—and the apes respond with total indifference.

item.title: Italy’s Espresso Machine Returns As WBC Dugout Turns Into Coffee Bar
item.description: Italy brings back its dugout espresso machine for the 2026 World Baseball Classic, blending baseball and Italian coffee culture in a blowout win over Brazil.

item.title: Feminist Film 'The Bride!' Becomes Latest Gigantic Hollywood Box Office Disaster
item.description: Hollywood just hit a new low as Maggie Gyllenhaal’s $90 million feminist Frankenstein retelling "The Bride" collapses at the box office with disastrous opening weekend.

item.title: Livvy Dunne Wants To Get Into Acting And Hollywood Needs To Get On This ASAP
item.description: Livvy Dunne plans a Hollywood pivot after LSU gymnastics, revealing acting lessons and big-screen ambitions as the social media star eyes her post-college career.

item.title: Kyle Schwarber Leads Team USA To 9-1 World Baseball Classic Win Over Britain
item.description: Kyle Schwarber hit a two-run homer and Gunnar Henderson had four hits and two RBIs in a 9-1 victory over Britain on Saturday night.
